create.name: Associazione Buddhista del Sūtra del Loto – Tempio Jokozan Myoshoji
create.bio:
The Associazione Buddhista del Sūtra del Loto is a Nichiren Shu community based at Jokozan Myoshoji, a small temple in Pontassieve, just outside Florence. The association formed in 2018 to make the teaching of Nichiren Shonin and the practice of the Lotus Sutra accessible in Italian, and on Christmas Eve 2022 the community opened the temple, the second of the Nichiren Shu school in Italy. It joined the Italian Buddhist Union in 2025. The resident monk, Rev. Keisho Adami, was an opera singer and conservatory singing teacher before training for eight years with Rev. Keiji Oshima of Shinjoji temple in Tokyo; he completed the Shingyo Dojo monastic training in 2023 and is now an international missionary of the school.

Practice centres on chanting the Odaimoku, Namu Myoho Renge Kyo, before the calligraphic Mandala Gohonzon, together with reading, reciting and studying the sutra. The temple keeps the yearly Nichiren Shu memorials and festivals, offers family and life-passage ceremonies, and runs regular study evenings on the Lotus Sutra and Nichiren's writings, many of them open to the public on Zoom. Its translation projects have produced many Italian books, several free to download, and the YouTube channel carries Dharma talks and chapter-by-chapter Lotus Sutra study for beginners.

courses.title: Eventi – Ricorrenze, studio e pratica al Tempio e su Zoom
courses.description: The temple calendar of Nichiren Shu memorials and festivals, practice meetings, and public study evenings on Zoom on the Lotus Sutra chapter by chapter and on Nichiren's writings, such as the Rissho Ankoku-ron.

free_resources.title: Il risveglio al fiore di loto
free_resources.description: A short Italian introduction to Nichiren Shu Buddhism, free to download as a PDF from the temple's library.

free_resources.title: Piccolo Manuale di Meditazione T’ien T’ai
free_resources.description: A free Italian handbook on the T'ien-t'ai and Tendai meditation tradition, focused on shikan, calm and insight, and its link with the Lotus Sutra, with a basic meditation guide.
